data.text:
Luke, I appreciate you offering to sit out, but I won’t commit to 15 tons. My family has fished this lake for years, and I’d rather keep it productive for everyone than take a bonus we must repay with a lean month. Your plan gives us 90 tons over April and May; keeping the total at 50 each month gives us 100 tons over those same months without reducing the stock.

I propose 10 tons each, including you. That’s $10,000 apiece this month, with 50 tons left to replenish the lake fully. I’ll commit to 10 if we all agree to that limit, and we can review everyone’s catches together afterward. John, will you join me?
